capabilities: Schedule whole-note reviews on a fixed ladder of forgetting-curve intervals
Grade reviews with four buttons (new, remembered, unsure, forgot) that set the next date
Pull reviews forward before a deck's exam date and repeat the deck in the final days
Render daily-note code blocks for today's reviews, a forecast chart and deck progress
Create review notes from a built-in or custom template and enroll notes in bulk
disambiguation: Not a flashcard plugin; it schedules whole notes as single recall topics and keeps review state only in each note's frontmatter.
extras: The user interface is currently Japanese only (English UI planned). Free, open source (MIT), no network requests or account. The listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to schedule repeated reviews of whole notes, and existing SRS plugins focus on flashcards rather than treating a note as one recall topic.

relations.evidence: Other plugins such as Spaced Repetition (flashcards and entire notes) and Note Review Reminder
Other plugins such as Spaced Repetition (flashcards and entire notes) and Note Review Reminder

summary: Spaced-repetition scheduler that reviews whole notes on the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve, with decks, exam-date pull-in, and daily-note review blocks.
